desc: Read the input string S from standard input.
Construct a new string T = reverse(S) + '#' + S, where '#' is a separator not present in S.
Compute the KMP failure function (pi array) for T.
The last value in the pi array, `pi[-1]`, gives the length of the longest palindromic suffix of S.
Extract the prefix of S that is not part of this palindromic suffix, reverse it, and append it to S.
